name: bonsai-code
description: Bonsai Code: a Claude Code-style coding agent for your terminal (terminal/) running local models (models/).

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify terminal/src/cli.jsx --outfile dist/bonsai && chmod 755 dist/bonsai
scripts.install-cli: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.bonsai-code/app ~/.local/bin && cp dist/bonsai ~/.bonsai-code/app/bonsai.new && chmod 755 ~/.bonsai-code/app/bonsai.new && mv -f ~/.bonsai-code/app/bonsai.new ~/.bonsai-code/app/bonsai && sed "s|__REPO__|$PWD|" terminal/app/bonsai-launcher.sh > ~/.local/bin/bonsai.new && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/bonsai.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/bonsai.new ~/.local/bin/bonsai && echo "installed ~/.local/bin/bonsai: it rebuilds itself from $PWD when the code changes"
scripts.test:binary: bun run build && BONSAI_BIN=$PWD/dist/bonsai bun test ./terminal/test/app.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-menus.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-start.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-hub.test.mjs
